indicators.pattern: High-contrast Didone serif for section statements, paired with a grotesque for the hero and labels
indicators.justification: The reference uses this exact pairing: an all-sans hero wordmark and a high-contrast Didone serif for the large section statements. The serif stack is a substitution for an unidentified licensed family, not a fashionable choice.
referenceEvidence: 1440×900 hero capture (E-SHOT-HERO): wordmark is an all-sans grotesque
768 full-page capture, introduction and concept sections (E-SHOT-FULL-768): large statements are set in a high-contrast Didone serif
indicators.note: Family is estimated; the substitution is recorded in the Design Memory Map and implementation spec.

indicators.pattern: Negative tracking on hero and section display type (−0.035em and −0.02em)
indicators.justification: The reference display is set tight: the hero wordmark and the large section statements both show reduced sidebearings rather than default or positive tracking. The demo matches that optical setting.
referenceEvidence: Hero wordmark measured at 50px with a 49px baseline distance (E-MEASURE-HERO); tracking estimated at −0.03em from the 1440 capture
Section statements in E-SHOT-FULL-768 show the same tight, high-contrast setting

indicators.pattern: Ordered step numbering (01, 02, 03) in the approach section
indicators.justification: The numbers express a real three-stage sequence — brief and context, concept and spatial logic, documentation and delivery — not arbitrary section decoration. They are rendered as list content and hidden from assistive technology.
indicators.requirementReference: Approach section must communicate an ordered three-stage design process; numbers carry the order.

motionReview: Motion was reviewed separately under the Kumite motion anti-slop MAS-01…MAS-09 policy and the installed design-motion-principles skill: PASS. Source-supported: heading and hero-title rises (reference linereveal, 1.109s), hero image settle (scale 1.1→1, 2.4s), photograph fade (opacity, 0.3s), 4px scroll bar (.yap), link underlines and project image hover scale. Functional: 80ms pressed feedback and a 160ms mobile menu enter. MAS-05 (repeated fade-ins) and MAS-06 (page-load animation) are triggered in form but are source-supported exceptions: the reference itself reveals its hero and photography on entry, and the demo reproduces one documented mechanic per element instead of inventing section fades. The per-line SplitText stagger is intentionally not reproduced. No pulsing, universal hover scaling, springs, blur entrances, decorative loops or layout animation, and prefers-reduced-motion removes all of it. See implementation-spec.md section 8 and discrepancy-report.md section 5.
